zoe_cs: Quick follow-up: Seaborne needs CMK in their account, 7y WORM retention, cross-account delivery to analytics acct, and 3 static egress IPs. Please list immediate blockers.
devon_net: Need VPC CIDR, overlap check, and whether they want NAT GW per AZ with EIPs or a single egress appliance.
maya_sec: Compliance asks: S3 Object Lock Governance + MFA Delete for archival bucket, and proof-of-archival (manifest + checksum).
otto_kms: KMS plan: symmetric CMK in their acct. Will require analytics role ARN to grant decrypt. Can add time-limited Redwood support role with mfa condition.
max_engineer: We'll stream logs via Firehose to their bucket; need Firehose PutObject permission and kms:Encrypt condition. Suggest daily manifest with SHA256.
tim_seaborne: Confirm analytics acct 987650000000. No CloudHSM initially. We'll provide analytics role ARN and Splunk HEC IPs today.
zoe_cs: Actions: (1) Tim provide ARN + Splunk IPs (2) Devon propose EIP per AZ plan (3) Otto draft KMS policy + support trust (4) Maya produce retention runbook. Flagging renewal risk if retention not validated in 30 days.
ticket_bot: Created CS-8721: "Seaborne KMS + retention day0 gates". Follow-up in 48h.
zoe_cs: Thanks all — I'll compile and send to the customer by COB. If any other blockers (e.g., TLS cert pinning or SIEM token rotation), add now.
